$comment: The lint findings in code that was written before a rule was adopted, by file and by rule, as counted on the day the rule arrived. eslint.config.js turns each listed rule off for each listed file, and scripts/lint-allowlist.test.mjs fails when a count differs from what the rule finds: higher is new code that gets no exception, lower is a fix that must lower the count here in the same change. The list only gets shorter (docs/code-style.md).
